gpu.scope: total device; includes other resident processes

findings.evidence: 3 transactions reached the configured client concurrency or dispatch limit.
findings.caveat: The observation alone cannot locate a server-side queue.
findings.experiment: Replay at a lower offered rate while holding prompts and output caps fixed.
findings.tradeoff: A lower rate can improve deadlines and reduce useful capacity.
findings.falsifier: At equal workload, lowering the rate does not reduce missed admissions.

findings.evidence: 21 transactions reached the configured client concurrency or dispatch limit.
findings.caveat: The observation alone cannot locate a server-side queue.

findings.confidence: high for sampled queue; low for its cause
findings.evidence: Observed up to 1 waiting requests on a single metric series.
findings.caveat: Shared traffic or waiting on cache connectors can contribute. Compare offered load and client tails.
findings.experiment: Repeat with a dedicated replica and fixed arrival rates around the observed queue onset.
findings.tradeoff: A larger batch budget may raise throughput while worsening decode cadence.
findings.falsifier: No waiting or server queue latency on a dedicated replay with the same client tails.

findings.diagnosis: High KV occupancy coincided with preemptions
findings.evidence: Matching label series reached 100.0% occupancy and recorded preemption deltas.
findings.caveat: These are phase summaries. Event-level simultaneity and recompute cost were not established.
findings.experiment: Replay matched arrivals with lower context admission while checking workload fit.
findings.tradeoff: More KV headroom can reduce admitted concurrency or context.
findings.falsifier: Preemptions persist at low cache occupancy on a dedicated, matched replay.
